_about: Three cron-session cases lost before the cron reply pump existed. Shape and timing follow a real cron turn ledger and its claims (dt = seconds from the job's submit); prompt/session ids are synthetic and the texts are neutral stand-ins of the same form (a legacy <<<R:...>>> line, Telegram HTML, a [SILENT] job reply). In each case the job turn was claimed by the cron runner's ask() and the background agent's task-notification turn was claimed by nobody.

cases.name: pressfeed
